center_owner_rule: Inspect original RGB96 center2x2(47:49,47:49), a clean zoom and original input context. TARGET only for a clearly selected pallet surface across footprint; FOREIGN only for a clear other object across footprint; BG only for clear background/empty-gap across footprint. Mixed boundary, weak visual evidence or ambiguous selected-instance identity =>UNKNOWN. OriginalinputU or center4invalid =>UNKNOWN with separate reason. Do not infer native external/self cause or coordinate correctness.
crop_presence_rule: Separately observe whether any clearly selected pallet material is visible anywhere in valid originalRGB96. This coarse crop-presence observation is not named-native-part presence or exact-point truth. No constructed crop =>UNKNOWN. Do not substitute it for center owner or use ownerT prediction as a crop-presence classifier.
